title: Survives the Reload
description: The access token lives only in memory, gone the instant the tab reloads — but the voyage shouldn't end there. Confirm the silent-refresh-on-mount flow actually restores a full session, nav and all, without asking the passenger to sign in again.
successCondition: After logging in and reloading the browser tab, a test observes a brief "Loading…" state, then the dashboard renders with the same user's nav items and sidebar footer email as before the reload — no redirect to /login occurs. This is repeated across all four roles, and additionally verified that reloading while on a deep route (e.g. /billing, as a customer) lands back on /billing after the silent refresh, not bounced to /.
hints: This relies on AuthContext's refresh() call on mount reading the httpOnly th_refresh cookie — it only works if the cookie is actually present, so don't clear cookies between login and reload.
The loading state is brief but real — an assertion that fires before it resolves could see a false-negative flash of /login.
